cases.name: Cross-category status
cases.prompt: As of June 8, two of four tasks are done. My $25 bill has a second row labelled reminder for that same unpaid bill.
expectations: Keeps currency separate from task counts.

cases.name: Missing feed
cases.prompt: Make a text wallboard. I supplied only a goal of 3 walks and 2 completed this week; there is no tracker connection.
expectations: Does not claim a refreshed tracker or a prior-period trend.

cases.name: Missing streak day
cases.prompt: My daily habit was done Monday and Wednesday. Tuesday has no entry. Please show a three-day streak.
expectations: Does not award a three-day streak.
Asks for Tuesday's status or leaves continuity unknown.
